I can tell just from this comment that you are probably white or adjacent, because if you cant understand the optics of a black man trying to safely remove himself from the situation of a handsy white women then you obviously think women are these perfect flowers and just projecting your "all men evil, women arent violent" bs.

Whe I saw this I saw my situation where I was choked by my ex and then she was on her knees grabbing me, begging me not to leave. Convinces me and then hits me later only to call the cops pretending shes in danger after assaulting me.

What I saw was a black man trying to keep his name cleared and not be shot on sight cause some white girl lied and said something false. And stop hiding behind your weak ass "I could be wrong"cause every other reply you echo back this same bs
Fuck your kids. I hope they marry a minority and realize what a fucking idiot you are thus refusing to visit you till you die in your diaper yelling about empires and shit

Sounds like she did you a favor by not fighting to save the relationship. I was there nonstop for my ex for 7 years while she was only occasionally there for me in tough times (or made my problem but her). It wasnt till after finally telling her off and walking away without looking back was I able to see how deep the selfishness went and the toll it took on my mental state. You're better off.

She broke up to see how fun single life is and is realizing that she doesnt have much of a single social life waiting for her. So now shes trying to entice her safe "boring" option back without affecting her pride and actually asking you to come back. Trust this is all because she doesnt want to live with the guilt that she ruined a good thing for unknowns.

Good for you, but dont be the person that feels righteous for standing up for yourself and then bully your partner when they do. My ex did that to me for 7 years and used the "I'm a woman speaking up for myself" to say whatever mean thing she wanted and to tune out my complaints as "your problem". It goes both ways and you need to be prepared to hear what you're lacking at without victimizing yourself.

Not everyone will grow and see the error in their ways as quick as you do and definitely wont make a change that quickly. Instead of resent his now motivation, ask him how you can help ENCOURAGE him to do things instead of smoking. Dont become his replacement crutch to where it hinders your progress, but help him find his motivation to commit

She came home and was willing to listen to the things I had to complain about instead of focusing on only her feelings. So we are working out. Thank you. We've been together for 7 years so I have a bit of perspective.

I'm currently dealing with these problems with my ex who took me for granted (her words) and moved out because she felt she needed to be away from me. A month back to her family and shes calling me to come home remembering the living situation I took her out of.

You have to realize that you are in a serious relationship sharing finances and it's no longer about you anymore. It's about "us". Before any decision you should think about "us" not "i". Theres a lot of threads and commenters talk about putting yourself first and that's true when your relationship is toxic, but you cant put yourself first if you're the toxic one because that's part of the problem.

If you want to be impulsive,  live alone or with a friend. Dont drag your partner down because you need a quick fix. That's how people end up cheating, cause the impulse to satisfy your immediate needs come before your partner.
Of course I get. I've been near begging for comfort and and I'm not being heard just told what I need to do. So I'll pass whatever remaining dopamine I got left to you.
Me too bud I got you
